settings.hero_alt: Get them the whole set. All eight Evolution Companions plushes in a styled campaign scene.
settings.hero_title: You don’t have to guess their favorite.
settings.hero_body: Give them all eight. Eight separate plush companions, one complete collection, $160 for the whole set.
settings.story_title: Let them discover you got every one.
settings.story_body: They’ll recognize the first face. Then the next. Keep bringing them out until the whole lineup is there. You didn’t have to choose between their favorites.
settings.size_body: After the wrapping’s gone, the fun is finding everyone a spot. One beside their pillow, a few on the shelf—little reminders that you knew what they’d love.
settings.proof_title: You can probably guess which one they’ll grab first.
settings.proof_body: Look at the little faces and picture the one they’ll reach for first. Then imagine telling them the other seven are theirs, too.
settings.final_body: The complete eight-plush set for $160. You choose how to wrap it; all eight companions are included.
settings.point_1_body: The little faces they recognize. A whole set that says you were paying attention.
settings.point_2_body: Give them all eight together and let them decide who gets the best spot.
settings.point_3_title: Let them show you their favorite
settings.point_3_body: You brought every one. Now you get to hear why that particular little face is the one they love most.
